x-q4t.semantics: Structural shapes include required planned capabilities. Shape validity does not promise that a model, tool or state executor is available. Check native planning and runtime capabilities; pending capabilities remain required implementation tasks.
adaptations: SDK-added output_text is optional on wire
FileObject.purpose includes evals already accepted by the SDK FilePurpose input; preserve the actual purpose
Files multipart uses binary file and bracket-encoded expires_after fields; explicit native capacity and storage quotas remain separate
Files HTTP list uses string first_id/last_id; native empty pages use empty strings and has_more=false, not nullable cursors from other list resources
official HTTP examples use usage:null for active/cancelled responses; completed/incomplete require actual usage
native store echo and native response error codes
count endpoint uses actual model templates; native create also accepts the model-owned friendly/pragmatic personality presets from the count SDK contract
optional q4t_moderation_usage discloses bounded auxiliary classifier tokens separately from business usage
SDK-documented include_obfuscation adds optional string padding to delta events only
official prompt caching guide permits 12h on request/applied options in addition to the pinned SDK 30m literal
exact integer and bounded native options
native cancellation credentials and timeout/seed extensions
SDK combined body/query split on actual HTTP boundary
compact output is a replayable input window including preserved user messages; only this SDK OutputItem[] inconsistency is adapted

wire_references.contract: Request and breakpoint TTL 30m/12h; exact eligible boundaries; overlapping read/write token accounting
Optional client-scoped short-lived hashes; unavailable never fails generation; terminal SSE carries comparison
Cancelled resource can have usage:null; no fabricated zero usage
Standalone compact preserves user messages and returns the canonical next input window with encrypted compaction state
response.created example has usage:null; successful final usage includes cache_write_tokens

x-q4t.cancelled_stream: Resource is cancelled; original events end without fabricated response.cancelled/completed or Chat DONE.
x-q4t.query: Closed route-specific fields; repeated include[] is an array; exact decimal integers and true/false booleans.

request.description: Chat input contract; optional visual inputs require the explicit media profile.

serve-config-v1.schema.json.description: Q4T private extension, not an OpenAI or vLLM endpoint compatibility claim.

oneOf.description: Optional for historical v1 records; emitted by the media admission implementation. Logical source/decoder/workspace limits do not reserve physical RAM.
Native media v2 includes temporal grouping and actual execution constraints.
Native media v3: static GIF and per-image detail/resize policy; historical versions retain their exact schemas.

max_inflight_requests.description: Requested auto sentinel 0; effective value derived after startup budget. Request count, not RAM or connection reservation.

max_queued_requests.description: Requested auto sentinel -1; effective value derived after startup budget. Request count, not RAM or connection reservation.

client_policy.description: Immutable startup binding. The v3 snapshot is not the currently applied policy; see current_client_policy.

application_state.description: Present when the native application object store is implemented; absent in historical config-v1 records.

responses_background.description: Present when native background Responses is implemented; current runtime recovery state, independent of model readiness.

cache_io.description: Native optional cache worker observations. Omitted in historical config-v1 records; all buffers and worker memory use unified RAM. Buffer cap excludes process/library metadata overhead. Observed RSS is the last reported maximum, zero is unknown when worker_rss_known is false.

current_client_policy.description: Current atomic model policy, distinct from the startup binding; publisher loss does not erase an installed policy. No credential values are exposed.

application_startup.description: Present in native application initialization recovery builds; omitted by historical config-v1 producers.

native_embedding.description: Optional fixed native model declaration; historical config-v1 producers omit this property. Enabled describes configuration, not current backend health.

native_embedding_health.description: Independent backend observation. Missing or invalid assets never request a primary model restart; genuine CUDA faults still invoke global device protection.
